title: Stream an LLM Response Word by Word with curl
description:
Why wait for the whole answer? Make your AI type it out live. ⚡

✅ Add stream true to your Claude API request
✅ Use curl -N so output isn't buffered
✅ Pull each text delta out with jq

Day 2 of Build AI Apps. Next up: Day 3, Get Structured JSON Every Time.
Follow for a new short every day and ship your own AI app.

#shorts #ai #coding #llm #api #tutorial #programming
comment: Curl or Python: which would you stream with? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: the text arrives in content_block_delta events, so jq can skip every other event.
